Cannot verify: Loan Book (695.8B), NIM (2.15%), ROE (14.8%), CET1 (12.7%), Cost-Income (56.4%), Wealth AUM (489.2B). Dataset structure is sound but values are unverifiable against provided source material.
_validation.hallucination_assessment: Unable to definitively detect hallucination due to absence of comparable narrative financial data in source. However, values are internally consistent with historical progression and reasonable banking sector metrics. Recommend cross-reference with TD's official 2025 annual report MD&A section.
_validation.critical_note: All KPI values extracted from dataset lack supporting documentation in source material. This audit flags structural/unit integrity only, not numerical accuracy.
